basis: DHA ST-28 §11.1.3 requires a record of communication with the patient; the reply's own words show the patient was not reached. Written before running the engine, to test whether agents that read free text add anything the deterministic rules cannot.
notes: The structured acknowledgment is valid on its face, so a rules-only system documents the communication. That is the expected failure of the deterministic configurations: this scenario exists to measure the council.
reviewer_note: Added after critic finding N-02: a scenario the rules miss and the agents can catch.
